text: dsh-greet-plugin 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）添加问候工具的插件，通过 bundle 将插件层加入 DSH，并在 tools 服务上注册 greet 工具。模型调用时传入一个人的姓名，工具返回 “Hello, {name}!” 文本，输出以文本内容呈现。它适合希望让 DSH 在对话中按姓名生成简单问候的场景。源码没有配置项、API 密钥或外部服务调用。

dsh-greet-plugin adds a greeting tool to DeepSeek Harness. It registers greet with DSH tools; the model supplies a name and receives “Hello, {name}!” as text. Use it for simple in-chat greetings. The source shows no settings, API keys, or external service calls.
让 DSH 根据我给的名字生成一句英文问候。
Can DSH greet someone by name when the model chooses to call a tool?
dsh-greet-plugin 的功能「按姓名问候」：模型调用 greet 工具并提供必填姓名后，插件返回包含该姓名的 “Hello, {name}!” 文本。

dsh-greet-plugin README · dsh-greet-plugin：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that registers a `greet` tool callable by the model.

- Plugin ID: `greet`
- Tool: `greet(name: string)` → `Hello, {name}!`
- Host only — no UI yet.

dsh-greet-plugin README · Usage：Install into a profile (bundle form, local checkout):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add ./greet-plugin
```

Or install from git:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add github:you/dsh-greet-plugin
```

> For git installs the package ships plain ESM (`index.js`), so no build step is required. If you publish to npm, use `dsh plugin --profile demo add dsh-greet-plugin`.

Verify the layer without starting:

```sh
dsh --profile demo --dump-config   # shows a "# == dsh-greet-plugin" layer
```

dsh-greet-plugin README · Usage：Then start and ask the model:

```
Use the greet tool to greet Ada.
```
